purpose: Consolidate cross-track constructs and prevent multiple policy contributions from claims describing the same evidence or downside.
contributionRule: A decision evidence atom has one primary contribution path. Member claims may constrain, calibrate, explain or change confidence, but cannot each add an independent score contribution unless a dependency audit proves distinct constructs.

constructs.name: Preference and segment prior
constructs.primaryContributionPath: explicit hard constraint or preference; otherwise a weak, uncertainty-labelled prior
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Trip purpose, party label, profile and demographic context cannot each add a bonus for the same inferred need.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Explicit-preference override and subgroup fairness tests

constructs.name: Missingness, ambiguity and evidence readiness
constructs.primaryContributionPath: observation confidence and decision readiness
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Unknown evidence cannot also act as a negative quality or risk event unless a separately observed downside exists.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Missing/false/present metamorphic suite and selective-prediction curve

constructs.name: Category expectation and classification provenance
constructs.primaryContributionPath: scheme-specific expectation context and peer eligibility
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Stars, the facilities implied by the scheme and individually observed amenities cannot be rewarded three times.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Scheme/version provenance, feature-level fit and cross-system holdout

constructs.name: Review evidence and uncertainty
constructs.primaryContributionPath: aspect-level experienced-quality evidence with provenance and uncertainty
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Overall rating, count, topics and provenance are inputs to one evidence object, not independent quality bonuses.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Platform/time holdout, denominator checks, aspect annotation and calibration

constructs.name: Price state, peer distribution and reference point
constructs.primaryContributionPath: complete total placed in a compatible, coverage-labelled distribution
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Budget under-run, peer percentile, displayed anchor and absolute saving must remain distinct and cannot all reward the same low price.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Canonical histories, compatible peer tiers and anchor-provenance tests

constructs.name: Cancellation loss, option value and preference
constructs.primaryContributionPath: time-indexed monetary loss scenarios followed by separately calibrated risk/liquidity adjustment
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Refundability bonus, expected loss, loss aversion and regret cannot be added as four versions of the same downside.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Exact schedule parser, date-certainty sensitivity and consented outcome calibration

constructs.name: Duration and recurring exposure
constructs.primaryContributionPath: explicit fixed, per-night, per-use, threshold or diminishing interaction
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Stay length cannot multiply every comfort, location and risk component implicitly.
constructs.promotionRequirement: One-to-28-night metamorphic series and prospective use/outcome data

constructs.name: Group fit, preferences and vetoes
constructs.primaryContributionPath: per-member hard fit followed by an explicit aggregation rule
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Party label and member-specific needs cannot both contribute the same preference; hard vetoes cannot be averaged away.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Veto preservation, chooser/companion outcomes and group fairness metrics

constructs.name: Pareto frontier, near tie and abstention
constructs.primaryContributionPath: one decision-state machine after eligibility, sensitivity and robustness
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Near tie, insufficient evidence, no eligible option and excessive risk are distinct states, not score penalties.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Frozen state labels, abstention precision/coverage and robustness tests

constructs.name: Confidence, reliance and outcome calibration
constructs.primaryContributionPath: defined outcome probabilities and separate reliance metrics
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Literature certainty, observation confidence and decision calibration are separate quantities.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Brier/reliability, hard-error, drift and subgroup validation

constructs.name: Exact offer identity, delivery and recheck
constructs.primaryContributionPath: property × room × rate-offer identity plus decision-level recheck diff
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Freshness changes confidence/bookability; it is not a quality bonus and cannot hide a substituted room or policy.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Identity-swap, term-change, sellout and recheck failure tests

constructs.name: Adaptive low-effort elicitation
constructs.primaryContributionPath: provider/provenance retrieval first, then one question with material expected decision value
constructs.antiDoubleCount: The Library's full facet schema must not become a mandatory questionnaire.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Question-value, burden, error and correction evaluation

constructs.name: Accommodation product type, allocation and scheme
constructs.primaryContributionPath: type selects the evidence ontology and compatible cohort; exact sellable-space and allocation identity establish the product
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Type, scheme grade, allocation mode and unit identity are context and integrity evidence, never four independent quality bonuses.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Cross-type label-null, exact-unit swap, allocation-range and cross-scheme tests

constructs.name: Private and shared space fit
constructs.primaryContributionPath: per-space exclusivity and temporal access matched to explicit party requirements
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Private room, bathroom, entrance, host presence and dorm labels cannot each reward the same privacy preference.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Per-space isolation, paired-profile, curfew and capacity-preserving tests

constructs.name: Operational delivery and usable facilities
constructs.primaryContributionPath: exact-offer service calendar, operating constraints and party-specific usable facility set
constructs.antiDoubleCount: A facility catalogue, included benefit, service cadence and property label cannot independently reward one promised service.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Offer-link, calendar, closure, arrival-boundary and fee-partition metamorphic tests

constructs.name: Accessibility, safety and belongings evidence
constructs.primaryContributionPath: feature-and-route compatibility or scoped evidence sufficiency; never an opaque safety score
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Badges, type, self-report, reviews and appearance cannot separately imply compliance, trustworthiness or safety.
constructs.promotionRequirement: End-to-end route, unknown-vs-fail, portrait-invariance, equipment compatibility and official-warning tests

constructs.name: Camping, glamping and outdoor-site fit
constructs.primaryContributionPath: exact site/unit geometry, utilities, sanitation, weather protection and operating state
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Camping/glamping label, hookup icon, bathroom icon and nature/luxury copy cannot substitute for exact capabilities.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Vehicle boundary, connector/amperage, sanitation route, hazard recheck and label-null tests

constructs.name: Local nightly season and market regime
constructs.primaryContributionPath: night-specific compatible conditional distributions with explicit uncertainty and MIXED aggregation
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Month, weekday, lead time, peer percentile, type and regional prior are covariates of one local regime, not additive deal bonuses.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Rolling-origin, city/microzone/property/type holdouts, calibration and no-leakage tests

constructs.name: Availability, censoring and latent demand
constructs.primaryContributionPath: granular observed state first; latent demand only under an identified and validated censoring model
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Sold-out evidence, market compression, booking pace and unconstrained demand cannot each amplify the same missing inventory.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Provider-outage, restriction, available-only, synthetic recovery, drift and UNKNOWN tests

constructs.name: Event, calendar and weather context
constructs.primaryContributionPath: versioned covariates and attributable local counterfactual impact, otherwise no event/weather regime claim
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Calendar presence, venue distance, weather, observed price and availability pressure cannot each create an event-spike bonus.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Cancelled/null/overlapping event, catchment, issue-time, grid and feature-ablation tests

constructs.name: Feature provenance and lawful data use
constructs.primaryContributionPath: hard dataset/feature admissibility and replay lineage; explanatory confidence only after admission
constructs.antiDoubleCount: Provenance, licence and confidence do not prove truth or add utility, and one lawful source cannot be counted again through aliases.
constructs.promotionRequirement: Expired-purpose, deletion propagation, lineage/hash mutation and ranking-isolation tests
